Subject: Before you stow your gear: a quick end-of-season checklist
CTA: View the Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent -> https://www.northbayoutdoors.com/products/NB-TNT-02
Body: You put in the miles this season. Now is the time to make sure your gear is ready to do it again.

Start with your shelter. The Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02) is a 2-person, 3-season shelter built from ripstop nylon and packs down at 2.1 kg. Before you bag it for storage, run through these steps:

- Pitch it in the yard or a dry room and let it air out fully. Even a few hours of residual moisture can compromise seams and fabric over a long winter.
- Inspect the ripstop nylon for any small tears or abrasion points. A seam sealer and repair patch now takes five minutes. Finding a failed seam at the trailhead next June takes considerably longer to deal with.
- Check the poles for cracks or bent sections, and run the shock cord through your fingers to test tension.
- Wipe the zipper teeth with a dry cloth and apply a zipper lubricant if they're stiff.
- Store the tent loosely — not compressed in its stuff sack — in a cool, dry place.

The Ridgeline is a 3-season tent. It is not built for sustained winter conditions or heavy snow load, so if your plans shift toward four-season trips, plan accordingly.

Taking 20 minutes now means your shelter is dialed and ready when the next trip comes together.
